title: 发现风险，不等于选对协作协议
coreProposition: Detecting failure risk does not select an effective collaboration method or approve its cost.
articleSynopsis: Controlled math experiments distinguish strong failure detection from weak protocol-specific value prediction. Escalation must separately retain risk evidence, candidate value and budget admission, with an explicit uncertain fallback.
concreteScene: A magnifying lens reveals a cracked rectangular specimen while leaving it unrepaired.
causalChain: Diagnostic illumination reveals a defect, yet the repair instrument remains suspended before intervention.
titlePromise: Risk detection is an observation, not an automatic choice of remedy.
readerProblem: Broadcasting to more agents solely because confidence is low.
dominantSubject: A cobalt rectangular specimen beneath an orange inspection lens
visibleResult: The defect is clearer but the specimen remains unrepaired
authorityScale: Diagnosis permits consideration, not repair execution
materials: cobalt glazed ceramic, white holder, optical glass
lighting: bright diffused daylight and amber diagnostic illumination
userDirection: User requests bright regular familiar objects; use a normal inspection specimen rather than a sculptural arch. Previous two attempts excluded.
sanitizedPrompt: Bright realistic technology magazine photograph, wide 16:9. On a tidy white engineering workbench lies one perfectly rectangular turquoise ceramic test plate in a simple straight-edged white holder. A small real crack crosses the middle of the plate. A conventional circular magnifying glass with a coral-orange rim, mounted on one ordinary white inspection stand, is positioned over the crack and makes the crack clearly larger through its lens. The plate remains unrepaired. Familiar practical inspection equipment, clean regular shapes, straight rectangular specimen, natural proportions, beautifully clear optical glass, bright daylight, warm-white background, lively turquoise and orange accents, gentle shadows, closely framed around the specimen and lens, realistic high-key product photography, ample clear space, image-only editorial composition.
